distinction.linePrev: Of becoming football stars or millionaires
distinction.line: As long as the distinction between fantasy and fiction remains
stanza: When boys are just eleven they begin to grow in height
At a faster rate than they have done before
They develop curiosity and start to fantasize
About the things they have never thought of doing before
These dreams are no more harmful than
The usual thoughts that boys have
Of becoming football stars or millionaires
As long as the distinction between fantasy and fiction remains
